thread:
support-ops: FYI escalated from CS — BrightMart seeing p99 jump on apac-realtime after overnight driver/firmware push. p50 stable, p95 ~2x, p99 ~4x. Also a tiny uptick in auth fails. Can we triage?

tina: Which nodes/instances affected? can you paste a sample trace or request id? :eyes:

support-ops: sample trace pasted below — shows long server-side queuing before CUDA invocation, no client retries. route=apac-realtime, model=redwood-embed-v2-int8, rollout: nv-driver-515.4 -> 515.7 at 2026-03-15T02:10Z, nvme-fw rolled on subset.

```
REQUEST_ID=brt-9f2a3
server_queue_ms=420
kernel_wait_ms=380
cuda_launch_ms=18
status=200
```

deploy-bot: driver-rollout completed for apac-pool at 2026-03-15T02:10:24Z (nv-driver-515.7)

sam-eng: I see storage IO spikes on the same hosts ~02:05-02:20 — nvme qdepth and scheduler wait jumped. Can someone run iostat/dstat on apac-rt hosts?

jia: Pulled apac-rt-12 for debug — modelcache path /var/lib/modelcache showing high write latency, KV cache misses spiking. Host cpu stuck waiting on write() into pagecache. Looks like firmware/driver changed DMA path under small-batch workloads.

tina: Mitigation proposal: 1) drain affected hosts (12/13) 2) route traffic to eu1 fallback 3) temporarily disable modelcache writeback on apac. I can do 1+2 now if we agree. :thumbsup:

support-ops: Applying routing change: `POST /api/routes/apac-realtime -> eu1 (weight 60%)` — rolling now.

oncall-sre: Repro script (local): `curl -H "x-customer:brightmart" https://api.redwood.ai/realtime -d @payload` -> p99 780ms vs baseline 190ms. Strace shows blocking in kernel on write() /pagecache path. Could be host kernel+nvme interaction rather than pure CUDA.

sam-eng: Kernel versions are unchanged (5.15.0-88) but nvme firmware differs on some nodes; driver release notes mention small changes to sync path. I'll open a rollback window and start a bisect across fw revisions.

jia: Quick prod test: toggling background writeback (sysctl vm.dirty_ratio / vm.dirty_background_ratio) plus disabling aggressive modelcache writeback on apac-rt-12 lowered p99 to ~220ms in canary. Recommend applying as short-term fix.

tina: Applying sysctl change across apac pool and draining hosts. Rolling now and monitoring auth errors too.

support-ops: Customer reports improved latency and auth errors dropping after routing + sysctl. Keeping ticket open for post-mortem. Next steps: bisect driver vs nvme-fw vs writeback settings. Sam to own rollback plan and bisect.

sam-eng: On it — scheduling rollback window and coordinating fw rollback with infra. Will provide bisect checklist and telemetry queries. Thanks team <3
